# Pedalogical Developer On‑Ramp 🚀

Welcome to the **Pedalogical Developer Docs** — your single source of truth for getting a local development environment up and running in **less than 30 minutes** (coffee not included ☕).

Whether you are:

* **Totally new** to the project and need everything installed,  
* **Migrating** from our former SQL Server stack, or  
* **Returning** after a hiatus and just need a refresher,

> **Pro Tip**  
> Keep a terminal open next to these docs and copy‑paste as you go. Most commands are idempotent — if you run them twice nothing breaks.
